declaration.preface:
Recognizing the paramount significance of ethical conduct in shaping the trajectory of both business and society, Val Organics Private Limited wholeheartedly embraces a profound commitment to Ethical Governance as the cornerstone of our corporate ethos. We firmly comprehend that ethical governance transcends mere compliance and stands as a fundamental pillar of responsible corporate behavior, pivotal for fostering sustainable growth and cultivating enduring stakeholder trust.

Within Val Organics Private Limited, our Ethical Governance policy serves as a testament to our unwavering dedication to upholding the loftiest standards of integrity and accountability across all facets of our business engagements. We are resolutely committed to addressing pivotal governance issues, including, but not limited to, Corruption, Anticompetitive Practices, and Responsible Information Management.

In our unwavering resolve to effectively combat these challenges, we have assumed a proactive stance, implementing innovative measures that align seamlessly with the principles of Anti-Corruption, Conflict of Interest, Fraud, Anti-Money Laundering, and Information Security. Our meticulously crafted strategies are not only designed to meet but to surpass current regulatory requirements, thereby establishing a new benchmark for ethical conduct within our industry.
declaration.declaration: At Val Organics Private Limited, we are unwavering in our commitment to ethical governance, upholding the highest standards of integrity, accountability, and transparency. Our policy addresses key governance issues including corruption, anticompetitive practices, and responsible information management, setting a new benchmark for ethical conduct within our industry.
declaration.scope: This Policy is applicable to following sites and all of its employees, workers, contractors, sub-contractors and other stakeholders:

focusAreas: Ensure Transparency and Accountability in Operations

Ethical Excellence: We are guided by honesty, integrity, and fairness in all business dealings. We will not engage in activities that could be perceived as unethical or a conflict of interest.

We develop and implement a comprehensive Code of Conduct that clearly defines expected ethical behavior for all employees, directors, and officers. We will also establish a confidential reporting hotline for employees to raise concerns without fear of retaliation.
Create a work environment where employees feel empowered to speak up about ethical concerns and are confident leadership will take appropriate action.
Act honestly, fairly, and ethically in all business activities.
Demonstrate integrity and professionalism in interactions with stakeholders.
Disclose actual, potential, or perceived conflicts of interest.
Support a culture of openness, accountability, and ethical decision-making.
Report ethical concerns through established reporting channels.
Do not engage in dishonest, misleading, or unethical conduct.
Do not misuse authority or position for personal gain.
Do not conceal conflicts of interest.
Do not retaliate against individuals who raise concerns in good faith.
Do not ignore known ethical violations.
Uphold Anti-Bribery and Fraud Prevention: We strictly prohibit offering, promising, giving, accepting, or soliciting bribes or any form of undue advantage. All financial transactions must be accurate and transparent.

We implement a robust anti-bribery and corruption (ABC) program, including due diligence procedures for business partners and third-party vendors. We will also establish a clear process for reporting suspected fraud.
Comply with all anti-bribery, anti-corruption, and anti-fraud requirements.
Maintain accurate financial and business records.
Conduct due diligence on suppliers, agents, and business partners.
Report suspected fraud, bribery, corruption, or financial misconduct immediately.
Cooperate fully with investigations and audits.
Do not offer, give, request, or accept bribes, kickbacks, or improper benefits.
Do not falsify records, invoices, reports, or financial documents.
Do not engage in fraud, theft, embezzlement, or misappropriation of assets.
Do not conceal suspicious transactions or unethical conduct.
Do not bypass established approval and control processes.
Foster Competitive Fairness: We are committed to fair and ethical competition in all our business practices. We will not engage in any activities that could give us an unfair advantage over competitors.
We establish clear guidelines for interactions with competitors and industry associations. We will also comply with all applicable competition laws and regulations.
Ensure Val Organics' reputation for fair and ethical business dealings within the industry.
Compete fairly and ethically in all markets.
Comply with applicable competition and antitrust laws.
Make business decisions based on quality, value, performance, and legitimate commercial considerations.
Maintain transparency in commercial negotiations and agreements.
Seek guidance when competition law concerns arise.
Do not engage in price-fixing, bid-rigging, market allocation, or collusive practices.
Do not exchange sensitive business information with competitors.
Do not make false or misleading statements about competitors.
Do not participate in anti-competitive agreements or arrangements.
Do not abuse market position for unfair advantage.
Champion Information Stewardship: We recognize the importance of accurate and reliable information. We are committed to the secure collection, processing, storage, transfer, and disposal of customer, supplier, employee, and other third-party information.
We will implement policies and procedures for data security, privacy, and recordkeeping.
We will also establish protocols for the appropriate use and disclosure of confidential information.
Ensure all employees understand their responsibilities regarding data security and information confidentiality.
Achieve and maintain compliance with relevant data privacy regulations.
Protect confidential, proprietary, and personal information.
Follow established information security and data protection procedures.
Report cybersecurity incidents, data breaches, or unauthorized access promptly.
Maintain accurate and secure business records.
Do not disclose confidential information without authorization.
Do not access information beyond business requirements.
Do not store sensitive information on unauthorized devices or platforms.
Do not install unauthorized software or applications.
Do not ignore information security risks or breaches.
Ensure Transparency and Accountability i: We believe in transparency and accountability in all aspects of our business operations. We maintain open communication with stakeholders and disclose relevant information in a timely and accurate manner.

We establish clear communication channels and reporting mechanisms for stakeholders to raise concerns. We also conduct regular internal audits and reviews to ensure adherence to ethical standards and best practices.
Foster a culture of open communication and accountability within Val Organics.
Conduct annual internal audits focused on ethical compliance, with a detailed report presented to the Board of Directors.
Maintain accurate, complete, and transparent business records.
Cooperate with internal audits, reviews, and compliance assessments.
Ensure decisions are supported by appropriate documentation and approvals.
Take responsibility for actions and decisions.
Do not conceal, alter, or destroy records improperly.
Do not provide false or misleading information to stakeholders, auditors, or regulators.
Do not bypass established controls, approvals, or reporting requirements.
Do not withhold information relevant to investigations or audits.
Do not avoid accountability for errors, non-compliance, or misconduct.
Conflict of Interest Management: We expect all employees, directors, contractors, and business partners to avoid situations where personal interests conflict, or appear to conflict, with Company interests.
We are committed to maintaining transparency and objectivity in all business decisions.
Employees are required to disclose actual, potential, or perceived conflicts of interest promptly.
Disclose actual, potential, or perceived conflicts of interest promptly.
Act in the best interests of the Company.
Seek guidance when uncertain about a conflict situation.
Maintain transparency in personal and business relationships.
Follow Company procedures for conflict review and resolution.
Allow personal interests to influence business decisions.
Conceal relationships that may create conflicts of interest.
Participate in decisions where a conflict exists.
Use Company position for personal benefit.
Financial Integrity and Anti-Money Laund: We are committed to conducting business only with legitimate customers, suppliers, contractors, and business partners.
We strictly prohibit participation in money laundering, terrorist financing, or any activity intended to conceal the source of illicit funds.
We maintain appropriate controls to identify, assess, and manage financial crime risks.
Ensure transparency and accuracy in financial transactions.
Maintain complete and accurate financial records.
Conceal the origin or destination of funds.
Bypass financial review or approval procedures.
Supplier and Customer Ethical Expectatio: Val Organics Private Limited is committed to conducting business with integrity and the highest ethical standards. These guidelines outline the expectations for suppliers, and customers.
Uphold ethical standards in all dealings with Val Organics Private Limited.
Refrain from bribery and kickbacks; maintain transparency.
Comply Val Organics Private Limited 's Ethical Governance policy and any ethical requirements in contracts.
Engage in fair and ethical dealings with Val Organics Private Limited.
Avoid soliciting or accepting unethical favors during business interactions.
Adhere to ethical requirements outlined in contracts, agreements, or terms of service.
Report any concerns related to ethical behavior or products/services through designated channels.

responsibilities.duty: Champion Ethical Culture: Set the tone at the top by demonstrating a strong commitment to ethical conduct and leading by example.
Allocate Resources: Provide the necessary resources for implementing and maintaining the Ethical Governance Policy effectively.
Oversee Ethics Committee: Appoint and oversee the Ethics Committee, ensuring its independence and effectiveness.
Review and Approval: Approve any revisions to the Ethical Governance Policy.
Policy Oversight: Monitor compliance with the Ethical Governance Policy.
Review Policy Effectiveness: Review the Ethical Governance Policy periodically to assess effectiveness, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend necessary updates.
Investigate Concerns: Investigate allegations of ethical misconduct or violations of the policy.
Provide Guidance: Offer guidance and advice on ethical dilemmas faced by employees.
Recommend Improvements: Recommend updates or revisions to the policy as needed.
Reporting: Prepare periodic reports on the committee's activities and findings for Executive Management.
Develop and Implement Code of Conduct: Create and maintain a comprehensive Code of Conduct that details expected ethical behavior for all employees.
Training and Communication: Organize and deliver ethics training programs for all employees at regular intervals.
Confidentiality Hotline Management: Manage the confidential reporting hotline for employees to raise ethical concerns without fear of retaliation.
Investigate Concerns: Conduct initial investigations into reported ethical concerns and work with the Ethics Committee as needed.
Disciplinary Action: Implement appropriate disciplinary actions for violations of the ethical policy.
Follow Ethical Standards: Comply with the Ethical Governance Policy, Code of Conduct, and applicable company procedures.
Report Concerns: Promptly report suspected unethical conduct, conflicts of interest, or policy violations through established reporting channels.
Complete Training: Participate in ethics awareness and compliance training programs.
Maintain Integrity: Demonstrate honesty, fairness, and accountability in all workplace activities and business interactions.

policy.monitoring:
Val Organics Private Limited shall establish appropriate monitoring and reporting mechanisms to evaluate compliance with this Policy and support continuous improvement in ethical governance performance.

The Company shall:

Monitor progress against ethics-related objectives, targets, and commitments.

Track ethics training completion rates and awareness initiatives.

Monitor incidents related to bribery, corruption, fraud, conflicts of interest, anti-competitive practices, and information security.

Conduct periodic internal reviews and audits to assess compliance with this Policy.

Investigate reported concerns and monitor implementation of corrective actions.

Maintain records of ethics-related incidents, investigations, training activities, and compliance performance.

Report significant ethics and compliance matters to senior management and relevant stakeholders where appropriate.

Periodically review the effectiveness of this Policy and implement improvements where necessary.

The results of monitoring and reporting activities shall be used to strengthen ethical governance systems, improve risk management practices, and promote a culture of integrity, transparency, and accountability throughout the organization.
policy.reviewMechanism:
To ensure the continued effectiveness and improvement of the Ethical Governance Policy, the following review process shall be implemented:

The Ethical Governance Policy shall be reviewed at least annually, or earlier if significant changes occur in legal requirements, business operations, stakeholder expectations, or ethical governance practices by Ethics Officer.

The review process shall evaluate policy implementation, achievement of established objectives and targets, ethics-related incidents, audit findings, stakeholder feedback, and overall compliance performance.

Identified improvement opportunities, gaps, and emerging ethical risks shall be assessed to determine necessary updates or enhancements to the Policy and related procedures.

Any revisions to the Policy and associated training materials shall be communicated to relevant employees and stakeholders, as appropriate.

The outcomes of the review shall support continuous improvement and ensure that the Ethics Policy remains relevant, effective, and aligned with Val Organics Private Limited’s commitment to ethical business practices.
